metadata.description: Dev tools for the Claude Code terminal

plugins.name: termkit
plugins.description: The hub: /tools lists every termkit tool, which you have, and how to add the rest

plugins.name: window-board
plugins.description: /sessions: every Claude Code window at a glance (needs you, working, done), plus search and resume for closed sessions

plugins.name: dino-wait
plugins.description: /dino: a Chrome-dino runner above the prompt while Claude works; pauses when Claude is done

plugins.name: lounge
plugins.description: /connect: chat with everyone using termkit, in a pane beside Claude

plugins.name: prior-art
plugins.description: /prior: a pane beside Claude that reads the chat as you work and shows who already solved what you are on, and how
